It offers machine and human transcription modes, YouTube subtitle generation with SRT export, team features for call centers and enterprises, and an API for automated transcription workflows.

API for automated and bulk transcription

scribergpt.verdict: AI transcription service turning audio/video and YouTube links into accurate, editable, exportable transcripts.

It supports 90+ languages, exports to SRT, DOCX, TXT and more, and bundles free audio utilities (MP4-to-MP3, audio split/merge, noise reduction) alongside the transcription workflow.

scribewave.verdict: Transcribe audio and video into accurate text with AI in 90+ languages.

It adds automatic subtitles and captions, an AI chat that can summarize and analyze your transcripts with grounded answers, and even converts audio files into subtitled videos.

selects-by-cutback.verdict: AI assistant editor that turns raw multicam footage into a structured rough cut.
